name: Midsummer blue
story: A soft southerly, a sky of high, dappled altocumulus catching the low sun, and a night that is only a long blue dusk. The air turns humid late: the valleys may be misty by morning.
forecast: Fair. South 6-8 kt. Altocumulus from 15:00 at 3800 m. Visibility 40 km. A blue, twilit night, broken high cloud; mist possible in the valleys by dawn.
